title: Chiang Mai Community Tracks
subtitle: Beginner-friendly enduro GPX routes around Chiang Mai
intro: Easy GPS tracks for beginners. All are outside national parks and not restricted, except the Mae Khanin river loop, which is closed during smoke season.
restricted: Please ride these community tracks instead of Doi Suthep or Hang Dong, which are restricted areas.
contribute: Help keep the tracks current: record your rides and send the recording to Pavel in the group if you find a deviation or a new "no off-road" sign.
